description: Op-shaped job that detects orphaned partition materialization events for assets whose PartitionsDefinition has been re-shaped. Reports by default; opt-in wipe when threshold exceeded.

asset_keys.label: Asset Keys
asset_keys.description: Empty = all partitioned assets in the code location.

wipe_on_detection.label: Wipe on Detection
wipe_on_detection.description: If true, wipe the entire asset when stale partitions are detected. Destructive.
